versions.content: Service Name EthSwt_VerifyConfig Syntax Std_ReturnType EthSwt_VerifyConfig ( uint8 SwitchIdx, boolean * Result ) Service ID [hex] 0x31 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) SwitchIdx Index of the switch within the context of the Ethernet Switch Driver Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) Result Result of verification, TRUE: configureation verified ok, FALSE: configuraton values found corrupted Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Configuration verificaton succeeded, E_NOT_OK: Configuration verification not succeeded. Description Verifies the Switch Configuration depending on the HW-Architecture, HW-capability and the intended accuracy of this verification. Available via EthSwt.h
